name: Jægersborggade Julelystænding 2024
description:
Kom og vær med til at tænde gadens smukke julebelysning lørdag d. 16. november kl.17.00-18.00 i indhakket mellem @keramikeringevincents og @paesanocph 🎄

Traditionen tro - serverer vi den dejligste dejlige julegløgg, kakao og æbleskiver. Vi serverer også varm risengrød med kanelsukker og smørklat fra @groedcph🎄Gratis og så længe lager haves;)

Derudover kommer fantastiske @choir.club forbi og synger julen ind med os❤️‍🔥

Program/
17.00-18.00 Gløgg, kakao, æbleskiver og risengrød
17.25 - Fællessang og fællesnedtælling 
17.30 - Julelyset tændes og Choir Club synger julen ind

ALTID hvid jul i Jægersborggade - de svævende, lysende ‘snefnug’ gennem gaden er lavet af genbrugsplast og LED🎄

Kom og vær med til at slå et slag for den fysiske handelsoplevelse og det fysiske handelsliv❤️‍🔥

Kh.
 Butikkerne i Jægersborggade

PS.
Desuden hjælp os med at sprede julebilleder fra gaden i de kommende måneder med hashtagget #altidhvidjulijægersborggade❤️

name: Songwriters Night At Operaen
description:
On November the 14, Operaen invites to a songwriters night with some of the most talented artists in the scene today. Join the movement!

About The Artists:


CELINA CALI

Copenhagen based singer/songwriter focusing on beautiful harmonies and lyrics, quiet sensitive music based on piano and guitar. “I write music as therapy for myself and hope that it will touch others too. My songs are hope, heartbreak and social criticism.”


ILMO

Ilmo is a multitalented Danish/Finnish artist. Apart from having a career as a professional tap dancer, Ilmo is also a sounddesigner, DJ, teacher, and composer. For this evening Ilmo will be presenting some of their more uplifting groovy tunes with greasy basslines.


AGGEMANIA

With an authentic and deep musical expression, Aggemania creates a special experience on stage, where emotions are given free rein in an atmospheric and dreamlike universe. 
The musics journey through the unconscious opens up a powerful fusion of inner struggle and liberated energy, where the hidden sides of the soul are allowed to flourish. 
In his lyrics, Aggemania explores his relationship with the ego and the transformative struggle he goes through to embrace his true self. 
The concert will be an exclusive pre-release, where the audience will get a first glimpse of Aggemania's debut mixtape Manisk Mixtape, which will be released on November 15.


A SYMBOL HEAVY

A Symbol Heavy is the one-man band project of Mikkjal Olsen, drawing on elements from grunge and heavy metal with memorable melodies sung by a loud voice and with guitar parts as they’re known from heavy metal interludes and acoustic rock.
While recordings available on Spotify feature a full band setup, tonight’s concert will be stripped down to an (almost) acoustic set with just guitar and vocals.


TRUTH RAY ,from the Copenhagen Hvaall crew, digs into love, loss, and anxiety with his solo tunes, all wrapped up in his beautiful voice. Experience it live, as he unveils new tracks accompanied by the soulful strains of his electric guitar.


TIYER w. Marmelade Culture
Tiyer is a Copenhagen based composer drawing upon many genres in his music, pulling the listener into a dreamy yet energetic world of stories, dynamic expression and surprises, where a longing for unity is a recurring theme, in a versatile musical landscape where truthful expression is prioritized over anything else. The music is a approached as an open canvas where the only goal is meaningful exploration of reality, and where the idea of "good" and bad" music doesnt exist. In other words, total freedom. Tiyer began his career as a musician in the Copenhagen electronic music scene as a part of the music collective Marmelade Culture, creating communities around experimental and electronic music with other producers, with new concepts such as Electronic Jams and Mics that up until that point had only been seen in the UK. This debut was well recepted, and within a short timespan catapulted its creators into the entire Copenhagen music scene, teaming up with fellow Zealots from the songwriter scene, Jazz scene, Poetry Slam, demo and impro scene, and eventually reached international ground, with several shows throughout Europe every year. Lately the Marmelade movement has reached danish television on Kanal 1 and radio at 97,7 FM with the shows “Marmelade Magasine” and “Marmeladio”, focusing on artistic discussion, live collaboration and interviews. Tiyer is currently working on music for several video game titles to be released next year, and has worked on concerts, releases and workshops with a string of legendary musicians such as Elias Bendix, Tobias Trier, Malene Mortensen, Rikke Bjerre, Hannah Muir, Niklas Timmer Kristensen, Laust Eberhardt Bonnesen, Jesper Pyskow, Daniel Carlos Goldfield, Frederik Moth, Frederik Hjulmand, Christopher And The Lost Binocular, Mucky Kid and Normal Original, Ulrik Lindgren, Monika Banyte,, Bjarke Treufeldt, Oscar Schjerbeck, Pernille Isedora and the list continues, as well as freelance work for several radio, TV and live gameshows. Tiyer is also working as a booker and arranger for unique and innovative show concepts, such as "Forest Concerts" a concept created by multi-musician Oscar Schjerbeck, and personalised private concerts with pop acts like Tim Schou. Lately Tiyer has been focusing on personal, introspective songwriting, and will this night be combining that work with an eclectic set of different styles, performed with a full orchestra and choir.


PRE HEAT WARM UP:

The internationally renowned artist SNOWBALL will give the performance of a life time in a pre heat warm up from 17-18.45 arranged in collaboration with the music collective Marmelade Culture. Join The Movement!
